title: Every Male of This Animal Dies After a Single Mating Season

scenes.text: Every year, every male of this animal drops dead.
It's the antechinus, a tiny Australian marsupial. No predator does it. No winter does it.
The breeding season lasts one to three weeks, and the males spend it mating in sessions of up to 14 hours.
They stop making sperm before it even begins, so every hour counts. Stress hormones flood their bodies and never switch off.
Their immune systems collapse. They pick up infections, bleed inside, and die, usually before their young are born.
Fifteen species live this way. Not one father ever meets his young.

description:
Every year, at the end of a breeding season that lasts one to three weeks, all male antechinus die. These small Australian marsupials mate in sessions of up to 14 hours while surging hormones leave cortisol unchecked.
Their immune systems collapse and they die of infections and internal bleeding, usually before their young are born. A 2013 study of 52 marsupial species tied the strategy to extreme sperm competition.
Which animal has the strangest life cycle you know?
subject: antechinus marsupial
first_comment: In 2023 an antechinus was filmed eating a dead male of its own species right after the season ended. Which strange life cycle should we cover next?
